cards.title: Why it works
items: The smallest honest admission pipeline: author, blind rubric, single repair round, re-score, stop rule, single disposition — no native loop engine needed because the round count is structural
Blindness is load-bearing: the rubric re-reads the record AS COMMITTED, so an author cannot grade its own homework
Second disagreement stops to a human with the open question named — the lane that loops forever is the lane that never admits it needs a person

cards.title: Contract
items: {{nodes}} nodes, {{gates}} gates, {{branches}} branches: author -> gate -> rubric -> gate -> repair -> rescore -> disposition
The disposition join keeps a live dependency on the rubric, so agreement (pruned repair arm) still lands its single disposition
